guide-entry-18277a4334556a445f16c50e.description: Report of the International Law Commission on the work of its first session , 12 April to 9 June 1949 At its first session, in 1949, the Commission reviewed the topic on the basis of the memorandum prepared by the Secretariat. The topic was included in the Commission's provisional list of fourteen topics selected for codification. During the discussion on Rights and Duties of States, a proposal was submitted to include in the draft Declaration an article relating to the right of asylum. It was finally decided not to include such an article. Instead, Mr. Yepes was subsequently invited to prepare a working paper on this topic, for submission to the Commission at its second session. Discussion in plenary : 6th , 7th (20–21 April 1949), 16th , 19th , 20th (5, 12 and 13 May) and 33rd , 34th and 35th (3, 4 and 7 June 1949) meetings ILC Report, A/925 (A/4/10), 1949, part I, chap. II, paras. 15–16, 19 Yearbook, 1949

guide-entry-4ca11636845c94c5155a73e9.description: Report of the International Law Commission on the work of its second session , 5 June to 19 July 1950 At its first session, in 1949, the Commission had invited Mr. M. Yepes to prepare, for its consideration, a working paper on the topic of the right of asylum (33rd meeting on 3 June 1949). At the beginning of the second session, Mr. Yepes stated that, in view of the fact that a case involving the right of asylum was pending before the International Court of Justice, he would postpone the submission of his working paper which had already been prepared. The Commission accordingly decided not to include the topic in the agenda of its second session . ILC Report, A/1316 (A/5/12), 1950, part I, chap. I, para. 12 Yearbook, 1950, vol. II
